description: ( SRE ) Eolien terrestre, parcs éoliens de Vendée is a dataset listed in Data.vendee.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. Un parc éolien est composé de une ou plusieurs éoliennes produisant de l'électricité. La définition du parc éolien n'a aucune assise administrative ou réglementaire. Il s'agit d'une classe purement abstraite correspondant à un agrégat d'éoliennes. La géométrie polygonale d'un parc éolien n'est qu'un artifice proposé pour cartographier les éoliennes à petite échelle. Coverage: Vendée. The portal files it under Territoires, Environnement. Its keywords are Energie, éolien. The portal shows 72 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-vendee-fr-portal.
